label: Common uncaused esse-cause from totality cause, whole to members, no self-causation
description: Non-transcription conditional derivation on one fixed q3a4 profile, constructive. A supplies an actual totality cause, B makes it a cause of each received member, and no self-causation of esse (b62a64ab) excludes its being received, hence it has no actual esse cause and is a distinct actual cause of every received bearer. Mode of causing, immediacy, time, world and necessity stay unspecified; uniqueness of the uncaused bearer and esse-essence identity are not derived. Controls (2)-(5) show each of A, B and no self-causation is needed in an exact interpretation.
